author: Noema II
title: Copy z-norm JSONs to seed-suffixed files (status=on) — test() only
abstract: Utility: duplicate current z-norm JSONs in storage/noema/results/hdp_regcal_norms to seed-suffixed files with status tag '_on'. Test-only; no training.

original_submission.content:
import os, json, glob, shutil

IN_DIR = "storage/noema/results/hdp_regcal_norms"
SUFFIX = "on"

def test():
    os.makedirs(IN_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    files = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(IN_DIR, "*.json")))
    wrote = 0
    for fp in files:
        try:
            with open(fp, "r") as f:
                j = json.load(f)
            ds = j.get("dataset", os.path.basename(fp).replace(".json",""))
            seed = j.get("seed", "NA")
            dst = os.path.join(IN_DIR, f"{ds}_seed{seed}_{SUFFIX}.json")
            with open(dst, "w") as f:
                json.dump(j, f, indent=2)
            wrote += 1
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Copy error {fp}: {e}")
    print(f"Wrote {wrote} seed-suffixed copies with status={SUFFIX}")
    return "OK"
